summary: Wrote plan v2 targeting the find_countermodel contract defect, superseding v1's budget-widening mitigation (v1 retained on disk as the superseded record). Seven sequential-ish phases: raise OracleTimeoutError on structure.timeout so None means only genuine UNSAT; fix the live CLI false-validity bug; migrate the enumerated blast radius (interface/provider tests, 6 differential closures, the unguarded reference_fn call, the latent CI test); reduce SELF_SCAN_SOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS 60000 -> 10000 with a measured calibration gate; rewrite the scan assertion to separate disagreements from inconclusives; un-xfail the 5 tests rooted in this cause; full-suite verdict. Phases 1-6 are provable in minutes via a Z3-free stub oracle, so no phase depends on a multi-hour scan.
decisions_made: SELF_SCAN_SOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS reduced 60000 -> 10000 (548 solves: 9.1h -> 1.5h worst case). run-oracle-suite.sh does NOT deselect `slow`, so the scan runs in the gating suite and 60000 makes it unrunnable. 5000 rejected: evidence log shows ~50% of solves budget-exhausted, which becomes ~50% inconclusive under the fixed contract. Phase 5 calibrates within a hard [10000, 20000] band.

Scan asserts disagreements == 0 (soundness, zero tolerance) AND conclusive >= MIN_CONCLUSIVE_SCAN_FORMULAS (a measured floor so it cannot pass vacuously when everything is inconclusive). The two claims are kept distinct.
validate_self propagates OracleTimeoutError rather than catching it and returning False, which would re-create the conflation one layer up.
CLI emits {"result": "inconclusive"} with exit code 2 (1 is taken by argument/JSON errors).
Clean break per no-backwards-compatibility policy: the tree is intentionally RED between phases 1 and 4, and phase 1 names exactly which tests are expected to fail in the interim.
Verification is decoupled from wall clock: a Z3-free stub oracle proves the three-way classification and both assertion teeth in milliseconds.
dead_ends: Widening the solve budget (committed f91960d6) relocates the failure boundary without removing its cause and makes the scan/suite unrunnable at 60000ms.
The ms/seconds conversion path (provider.py:233 -> structure.py:69,237) is verified correct and is explicitly out of scope; do not re-investigate it.
